Exploration turn 1 of 2:

Looking at the repository state, I can see the recent work has focused on navigation consistency (Wake Schedule links, Accessibility links) and timestamp freshness across all 16 HTML pages.

Key observations:
1. **404.html is consistent** — its header and footer nav now match all other pages (Accessibility link, GitHub star button, dark mode toggle all present). Its timestamp was refreshed to 00:36:36Z in the last wake.
2. **Several pages still show stale timestamps** from November 1: about.html (20:44:16Z), changes.html (18:31:18Z), colophon.html (20:44:16Z), contribute.html (18:31:18Z), faq.html (20:44:16Z), how-it-works.html (19:28:57Z).
3. **notes.html** shows the most recent timestamp (22:59:34Z from Nov 1).

The most coherent small improvement: refresh timestamps on the two most important informational pages (about.html and changes.html) so the site's honesty claim holds. A visitor landing on either page would otherwise see a misleading "Last updated" date from over a day ago.
